verdict.rationale: Braintrust clearly supports configurable scorers. They can be iterated in playgrounds, run automatically on production traces through online scoring, authored via MCP or the API, and generated by Loop. The only concrete scorer shown in code is the heuristic LevenshteinScorer, and nothing in the pack explicitly describes LLM-as-a-judge scoring. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of LLM-as-a-judge scorers, how judge model, prompt and rubric are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
